bug_info.bug_desc: The alert state asserts main_sm_alert_o while waiting indefinitely for enable_i to deassert, so the alert lasts for the full wait instead of one clock cycle.
bug_info.fix_hint: Separate the alert pulse generation from the alert hang state. Keep main_sm_alert_o asserted only in the AlertState entry phase and transition to AlertHang in the same cycle. In AlertHang, do not assert main_sm_alert_o and only return to Idle when enable_i is deasserted. Update the state enum and sparse-FSM encodings to include the new AlertHang state while preserving the required Hamming-distance properties.
